Vande Bharat Sleeper Train Launched Between Bengaluru and Mumbai

The Vande Bharat Sleeper express train service between Bengaluru and Mumbai has been launched. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the train. This is India's third Vande Bharat Sleeper train. A second service via Hubballi has also been announced for North Karnataka. The IRCTC food menu for the train includes items such as Idli, Masala Poha, Lemon Rice, and Sambhar.
